# SurgeLab

> SurgeLab is marketing on autopilot for small and mid-sized businesses. Its AI agents check how ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Claude find, describe and recommend a business, fix what they get wrong, and run its marketing every week: posting, reviews, Google listing and a weekly score out of 100. The customer approves, SurgeLab runs it. Based in London, working everywhere.

SurgeLab measures and fixes; it is not a dashboard. Every business gets a Front Door score out of 100, made of five gates scored 0 to 20 each: Found (does AI know you exist), Right (is what AI says about you true), Clear (can AI answer what is on offer and what it costs), Bookable (can a customer complete the booking or purchase), Proven (did it turn into money). Each week the score is re-checked and the lowest gate is fixed. Nothing publishes without the customer's approval. Works for restaurants, online shops, salons, consumer brands, trades and B2B alike. Pricing: one plan, Front Door, at £199 a month or £2,149 a year (10% off), excluding VAT, cancel any month. Add-ons: video and AI marketing agents, priced inside the tool. Agencies pay by brand count and book a call. Contact: support@surgelab.co.

## Services

- [Marketing on autopilot](https://surgelab.co/): what SurgeLab does, the five gates, how it works, add-ons, pricing and FAQ
- [Free AI audit](https://surgelab.co/audit): two-minute check of whether AI assistants find, describe and recommend your business, no card or account
- [AI marketing agents](https://surgelab.co/#agents): a roster of 25 single-job agents; hire two or more and The Chief of Staff joins free
- [Video add-on](https://surgelab.co/#video): branded clips with asset lock, best model chosen automatically
- [AI consultancy](https://surgelab.co/#consult): strategy days, team training and custom agents, with the founder
